summary: Implemented patch::apply_chart_edits_owned and OwnedPatchError, with recoverable validation failures and allocation-preserving in-place editing. Added nine integration tests. Final build, tests, Clippy, and formatting checks pass.

design_decisions: Both public editing APIs use the existing Planner through a shared internal plan_chart_edits helper. Validation checks ranges, stable splice ordering, overlaps, and representable final length before mutation.

The owned applicator compacts unchanged byte ranges forward, then inserts already-owned replacement fragments while copying retained ranges backward. It creates neither a full XML clone nor a second output buffer, and never needs transient capacity beyond the larger of original and final length.

OwnedPatchError privately owns the original Vec and PatchError, exposes error() and into_parts(), implements Debug and Display, and returns the typed PatchError from Error::source. PatchError gains the additive Error implementation. No error borrows the edits or scanner data.

Existing public signatures, enum variants, and public struct fields remain unchanged. Existing inline tests and configuration are preserved. Added guards replace unchecked template slicing, empty-series underflow, and debug-only metadata assumptions with existing typed errors. Invalid merged deletion spans and overlapping clone metadata are rejected.

Tests compare byte output for all edit variants, multiple same-anchor insertions, Unicode text, 125 combinations of replacement lengths with and without spare capacity, structural growth funded by deletion, recoverable error identity, detached error lifetimes, and malformed scanner ranges.
limitations: Validation was limited to the isolated chart crate and supplied toolchain; no full document-engine integration or visual rendering validation was performed.
Allocation preservation is tested using the returned vector pointer and capacity; no allocator instrumentation or performance benchmark was performed.
Allocation exhaustion retains normal Vec behavior; the existing PatchError variants provide no allocation-failure variant. Recoverable errors cover edit planning and validation.
